{{tocright}}
== Purpose ==

The purpose of {{t|ref}} and related templates is to easily create inline footnotes that are displayed at the bottom of the page. It should always be used instead of <code><nowiki><ref></nowiki></code> unless there is a reason the latter ''has'' to be used. '''Note that the use of equal signs in parameter values can break the reference. To fix this, use named parameters.'''

=== Related ===

{| class=wikitable
![[#Books]]!![[#Rignotes]]!![[#Theoryland]]!![[#Youtube]]!![[#Footnotes]]<!-- This should always be the last section! -->
|-
|style="vertical-align: top;"|{{t|ref/book}}
|style="vertical-align: top;"|{{t|ref/rignotes}}
|style="vertical-align: top;"|{{t|ref/tidb}}
{{t|ref/tidbkw}}
|style="vertical-align: top;"|{{t|ref/youtube}}
|style="vertical-align: top;"|{{t|notes}}
{{t|reflist}}
|}

== Usage ==

<code><nowiki>{{</nowiki>ref|''text''|''name''<nowiki>}}</nowiki></code>
<pre>{{ref
  | text = 
  | name =
}}
</pre>


=== Parameters ===

{| class=wikitable
!Parameter!!Notes
|-
|text||Specifies the content of the footnote.
|-
|name||Specifies the name of the footnote. This must be unique in the context of a page. If another footnote with the same ''name'' but different ''text'' exists, and error will appear.
|}

== Examples ==

{| class=wikitable
!Code!!Result!!Notes
|-
|<pre>{{ref|Lorem ipsum}}</pre>   ||{{ref|Lorem ipsum}}   ||Basic use case.
|-
|<pre>{{ref|Ipsum lorem|IL}}</pre>||{{ref|Ipsum lorem|IL}}||Named footnote.
|-
|<pre>{{ref||IL}}</pre>           ||{{ref||IL}}           ||Duplicate reference to a named footnote.
|-
|<pre>{{ref|Lorem ipsum|IL}}</pre>||{{ref|Lorem ipsum|IL}}||Invalid duplicate named footnote with deviant text.
|-
|<pre>{{ref}}</pre>               ||{{ref}}               ||<span style="color:red;">No parameters</span>
|-
| <pre>{{ref|[https://dragonmount.com/ Dragonmount]}}</pre>
|      {{ref|[https://dragonmount.com/ Dragonmount]}}
| Good external link
|-
| <pre>{{ref|[https://dragonmount.com/search/?q=robert%20jordan&quick=1 Robert Jordan on Dragonmount]}}</pre>
|      {{ref|[https://dragonmount.com/search/?q=robert%20jordan&quick=1 Robert Jordan on Dragonmount]}}
| <span style="color:red;">Broken external link (with <code>=</code> symbol)</span>
|-
| <pre>{{ref|text=[https://dragonmount.com/search/?q=robert%20jordan&quick=1 Robert Jordan on Dragonmount]}}</pre>
|      {{ref|text=[https://dragonmount.com/search/?q=robert%20jordan&quick=1 Robert Jordan on Dragonmount]}}
| Proper handling of external link with <code>=</code> symbol
|-
|}

= {{A|Books}}{{t|ref/book}} =

== Purpose ==

The purpose of {{t|ref/book}} is to reference a specific book or excerpt from a book, usually a {{wot}} book.

=== Related ===

* {{t|0}}, {{t|ns}}
* {{t|1}}, {{t|teotw}}
* {{t|2}}, {{t|tgh}}
* {{t|3}}, {{t|tdr}}
* {{t|4}}, {{t|tsr}}
* {{t|5}}, {{t|tfoh}}
* {{t|6}}, {{t|loc}}
* {{t|7}}, {{t|acos}}
* {{t|8}}, {{t|tpod}}
* {{t|9}}, {{t|wh}}
* {{t|10}}, {{t|cot}}
* {{t|11}}, {{t|kod}}
* {{t|12}}, {{t|tgs}}
* {{t|13}}, {{t|tom}}
* {{t|14}}, {{t|amol}}
* {{t|15}}, {{t|ros}}
* {{t|c}}, {{t|twotc}}
* {{t|bwb}}
* {{t|origins}}
* {{t|beasts}}

== Usage ==

<code><nowiki>{{</nowiki>ref/book|''book''|''chapter''|name=''name''|section=''section''<nowiki>}}</nowiki></code>
<pre>{{ref/b
  | book = 
  | chapter =
  | name =
  | section =
}}
</pre>

=== Parameters ===

{| class=wikitable
!Parameter!!Notes
|-
|book   ||Specifies the template used for citing a particular book. See [[#books]].
|-
|chapter||Specifies the chapter number being cited. For most books, it can also specify a '''p'''rologue, '''e'''pilogue, or '''g'''lossary (where applicable). For {{origins}}, it can specify a chapter name/nickname. For {{twotc}}, it specifies the wiki page to link to (''section'' specifies the display text). For {{beasts}}, it specifies the section/entry.
|-
|name   ||Specifies the name of the footnote. This must be unique in the context of a page. If another footnote with the same ''name'' but different ''text'' exists, and error will appear. If not provided, one will be derived from the other parameters. This is usually not needed.
|-
|section||For {{origins}}, sub-section of ''chapter''. For example, ''book'' '''origins''', ''chapter'' '''e'''ndnotes, ''section'' '''4''' might be used to reference {{origins|e|4}}: ''<nowiki>{{ref/book|origins|e||4}}</nowiki>'' See {{tl|origins}}. For {{twotc}}, specifies specific Old Tongue word if ''chapter'' was "Old Tongue Dictionary" or "otdict." For {{beasts}}, link display text.
|}

Multiple references to the same book/excerpt are automatically deduplicated together in the '''Notes''' section generated by the {{t|notes}} template (if the same template is used). For example, '''<nowiki>{{ref/book|1|2}}{{ref/book|1|2}}{{ref/book|teotw|2}}</nowiki>''' will produce two separate footnotes. The following table shows acceptable prologue, epilogue, and glossary values.

{| class=wikitable
!Prologues!!Epilogues!!Glossaries
|-
|Prologue||Epilogue||Glossary
|-
|prologue||epilogue||glossary
|-
|P       ||E       ||G
|-
|p       ||e       ||g
|}

For {{twotc}} or {{beasts}}, ''chapter'' may be the name of an entry. For {{beasts}}, ''section'' is interpreted as the display text for the link. For {{twotc}}, the footnote will link to a wiki page with the same name. For {{beasts}}, it will link to the entry on the {{beasts}} page.

== Examples ==

{| class=wikitable
!Code!!Result!!Notes
|-
|<code><nowiki>{{ref/book|1|1}}</nowiki></code>||{{ref/book|1|1}}||Singular reference
|-
|<code><nowiki>{{ref/book|2|1}} {{ref/book|2|1}}</nowiki></code>||{{ref/book|2|1}} {{ref/book|2|1}}||Multiple references
|-
|<code><nowiki>{{ref/book|3|1}} {{ref/book|4|1}} {{ref/book|3|1}}</nowiki></code>||{{ref/book|3|1}} {{ref/book|4|1}} {{ref/book|3|1}}||Multiple references separated by another reference
|-
|<code><nowiki>{{ref/book|5|1}} {{ref/book|5|1}} {{ref/book|tfoh|1}}</nowiki></code>||{{ref/book|5|1}} {{ref/book|5|1}} {{ref/book|tfoh|1}}||Multiple references to the same text using different templates
|-
|<code><nowiki>{{ref/book|twotc|Aiel}} {{ref/book|c|Aiel}}</nowiki></code>||{{ref/book|twotc|Aiel}} {{ref/book|c|Aiel}}||Reference to {{twotc}} entry
|-
|<code><nowiki>{{ref/book|twotc|otdict||gaidin}}</nowiki></code>||{{ref/book|twotc|otdict||gaidin}}||Reference to {{twotc|Old Tongue Dictionary}} entry
|-
|<code><nowiki>{{ref/book|c|Wars of Consolidation, or the Consolidation|Consolidation}} {{ref||Consolidation}} {{ref/book|15||R}} {{ref||R}}</nowiki></code>||{{ref/book|c|Wars of Consolidation, or the Consolidation|Consolidation}} {{ref||Consolidation}} {{ref/book|15||R}} {{ref||R}}||Named references
|-
|<code><nowiki>{{ref/book|beasts}}</nowiki></code>||{{ref/book|beasts}}||Beasts
|-
|<code><nowiki>{{ref/book|beasts|Bladetusk}}</nowiki></code>||{{ref/book|beasts|Bladetusk}}||Section/entry
|-
|<code><nowiki>{{ref/book|c|Aiel|A}} {{ref/book|c|Aviendha|A}}</nowiki></code>||{{ref/book|c|Aiel|A}} {{ref/book|c|Aviendha|A}}||Conflicting reference names
|-
|<code><nowiki>{{ref/book|origins|e||4}}</nowiki></code>||{{ref/book|origins|e||4}}||Subsection
|}

= {{A|Rignotes}}{{t|ref/rignotes}} =

== Purpose ==

The purpose of {{t|ref/rignotes}} is to reference [[Robert Jordan's notes]].

Related: {{t|rignotes}}

== Usage ==

<code><nowiki>{{</nowiki>ref/rignotes|box=''box''|folder=''folder''|pages=''pages''|prefix=''prefix''<nowiki>}}</nowiki></code>

=== Parameters ===

{| class=wikitable
!Parameter!!Notes
|-
|box||Rigney notes box number.
|-
|folder||Rigney notes folder number.
|-
|pages||Rigney notes page numbers.
|-
|prefix||Text to italicize and display before the rest of the footnote..
|}

== Examples ==

{| class=wikitable
!Code!!Result!!Notes
|-
|<pre>{{rignotes|1|2|3}}</pre>                  ||{{rignotes|1|2|3}}                  ||
|-
|<pre>{{rignotes|4|5|6|My favorite notes}}</pre>||{{rignotes|4|5|6|My favorite notes}}||
|}

= {{A|Theoryland}}{{TLlink}} =

The {{TLlink}} templates are used to reference Theoryland. {{t|ref/tidb}} references entries in the Theoryland Interview Database. {{t|ref/tidbkw}} references searches in the TIDB.

Related: {{t|TIDB}}, {{t|TLlink}}

== Usage ==

<code><nowiki>{{</nowiki>ref/tidb|''interview''|''question''|''title''<nowiki>}}</nowiki></code>

<code><nowiki>{{</nowiki>ref/tidbkw|''keywords''|''title''<nowiki>}}</nowiki></code>

=== Parameters ===

{| class=wikitable
!Parameter!!Notes
|-
|interview||The number of the interview.
|-
|question||The question number within the interview.
|-
|title||The title of the interview (display only). It is preferable to omit this parameter and instead update {{t|TIDB}} to map ''interview'' to the title.
|}

Consider the following {{Wiki|URL}}: {{Link|url=https://www.theoryland.com/intvmain.php?i=180#6}}

The ''interview'' is '''180'''. The ''question'' is 6. The ''title'' is '''tarvalon.net Q&A'''

== Examples ==

{| class=wikitable
!Code!!Result!!Notes
|-
|<pre>{{ref/tidb|180}}</pre>                      ||{{ref/tidb|180}}                  ||Interview
|-
|<pre>{{ref/tidb|828|1}}</pre>                    ||{{ref/tidb|828|1}}                ||Interview and question
|-
|<pre>{{ref/tidb|828|1|Lorep ipsum}}</pre>        ||{{ref/tidb|828|1|Lorep ipsum}}    ||Interview, question, and custom title
|-
|<pre>{{ref/tidb|828||Lorep ipsum}}</pre>         ||{{ref/tidb|828||Lorep ipsum}}     ||Interview and title
|-
|<pre>text{{ref/tidb|3|15}}{{ref/tidb|3|15}}</pre>||{{ref/tidb|3|15}}{{ref/tidb|3|15}}||Duplicate references
|-
|<pre>{{ref/tidb|10000|123}}</pre>                ||{{ref/tidb|10000|123}}            ||Interview with no automatic title
|-
|<pre>{{ref/tidb|10000||Bogus title}}</pre>       ||{{ref/tidb|10000||Bogus title}}   ||Custom title for interview with no automatic title
|-
|<pre>{{ref/tidbkw|jordan}}</pre>                 ||{{ref/tidbkw|jordan}}             ||Keyword search
|}

= {{A|Youtube}}{{t|ref/youtube}} =

== Purpose ==

The purpose of {{t|ref/youtube}} is to reference a specific youtube video.

== Usage ==

<pre>{{ref/youtube
  | v            = 
  | title        = 
  | accessdate   = 
  | channel      =
  | channel-link = 
}}
</pre>

=== Parameters ===


{| class=wikitable
!Parameter!!Notes
|-
|v||The video id.
|-
|title||The video title.
|-
|accessdate||The date the wiki editor viewed the video.
|-
|channel||The name of the channel
|-
|channel-link||The {{Wiki|URL}} of the channel
|}

= Footnotes =
<!-- This should always be the last section! -->
The {{t|notes}} template is used to add a footnotes section on the page. It should always be used instead of {{t|reflist}}.

== Purpose ==

Add a footnotes section

==How to use==

<pre>{{notes}}</pre>

{{notes}}
